Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 01-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. (CORE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: ECE 1071/ECE_1071 - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                An AC voltage of 220V, 50Hz is applied to transformer having turns ratio 10:1. The secondary of       (4)  
  transformer is connected to full wave bridge rectifier. The diode has cut-in voltage 0.6V and forward  
  resistance 10Ω. If the load resistance is 250Ω, determine the average and rms values of output  
  current and voltage. What should be the PIV rating of the diode?  
1B)                A Si diode has reverse saturation current 20 nA at 25o C.                                              (3)  
  a) Find the diode current when it is forward biased by 0.5 V.  
  b) Find the diode current when the temperature rises to 100o C forward bias voltage of 0.5 V.  
  
1C)                Explain the different types of breakdown mechanisms that can occur in a PN junction diode.             (3)  
2A)                Determine the Output voltage, Zener current, and power dissipation of a Zener diode regulator          (4)  
  circuit with a 16V input, 1kΩ series resistor, 10V Zener diode, and 3k Ω load resistor. Sketch the  
  circuit.  
2B)                Derive the drain current equation of a MOSFET in the triode region. Is it possible to determine the    (3)  
  values of µn C ox and W/L by applying different values of VGS - VTH and VDS and measuring ID  
2C)                Explain the I-V characteristics of a MOSFET and label the different regions of operation with          (3)  
  appropriate conditions.  
3A)                Draw the internal block diagram of the operational amplifier and explain the function of each block.   (4)  
  Mention the ideal characteristics of OPAMP.  
3B)                                                                                                                       (3)  
  
  
3C)                Perform the following using 2's complement method: Subtract (64)10 from (120)10                        (3)  
4A)                Obtain the simplified expressions for the outputs of a full-adder using K-map and implement the        (4)  
  same using only NAND gates.  
4B)                                                                                                                       (3)  
  
  
4C)                Construct a 3-bit down-counter using suitable positive edge triggered flip-flops and draw the output   (3)  
  waveforms showing all the possible states of the counter.  
5A)                A message signal 10cos(2000πt) amplitude modulates a carrier 40cos(2×106 πt). Find                     (4)  
  a) modulation index  
  b) Sideband frequencies,

c) Bandwidth,  
  d) Amplitude of each side band,  
  $$e) Power in each sideband assuming R = 50Ω.$$  
5B)   In an FM system when the modulating frequency is 50 Hz and modulating voltage is 2.5 V, the      (3)  
  deviation produced is 5 KHz. Calculate the modulation index. Now if the modulating voltage is  
  increased to 7.5 V, calculate the new frequency deviation.  
5C)   Binary data 10011 has to be transmitted using digital modulation techniques. Draw the digital    (3)  
  signal, carrier signal and modulation signal in each of the modulation techniques ASK, FSK and  
  PSK.
